from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class AssetRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extracted non-current assets data from a single company's financial statement."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company issuing the filing")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The end date of the reporting period")
    total_non_current_assets: float | None = Field(description="The reported value for Total Non-current Assets")
    currency_unit: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the value, e.g., 'thousands', 'millions'")
    source_quote: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim text containing the value for verification")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_assets: list[AssetRecord]
